create_robotiq_2f85_gripper: create a Robotiq2F85Mjcf gripper instance with custom gainprm and biasprm actuator parameters
build_gripper_with_tcp_orientation: build a Robotiq2F85 gripper with a custom TCP orientation quaternion for robot compatibility
initialize_episode_gravity_compensation: initialize a simulation episode by applying gravity compensation to all gripper body elements
